name: carousel-generator
description: Instagram 4:5 carousel generator with brand kits, golden-ratio slides and a visual editor
long_description: Generates Instagram carousels (1080x1350, 4:5) as editable HTML pre-loaded with content. Includes a visual editor with golden-ratio calibration, multi brand-kit support with live switching, logo images, and PNG export per slide.

tools.name: generate_carousel
tools.description: Generates an Instagram carousel as editable HTML (opens in browser), pre-loaded with slides and brand kit

tools.name: save_brand_kit
tools.description: Saves a brand kit JSON for reuse with generate_carousel

tools.name: load_brand_kit
tools.description: Returns the full JSON of a saved brand kit
